title: State parity rescue and operator surgical patch playbook for on-prem upgrade failures
creator: Asha Patel
description: Several customers reported stalled tenant upgrades and degraded inference capacity after on-prem Helm/operator upgrades. Root cause appears to be state-parity divergence between operator CRs and the tenant-scoped KV cache (kv-store) caused by an ordering regression in the Helm post-upgrade hook. Divergence leads to reconcile loops, controller backoff, and in some cases stuck Helm releases requiring manual intervention. This ticket drives three deliverables: 1) fast, conservative detection and alerting for state-parity anomalies pre/post upgrade; 2) a surgical hotfix (operator runtime change + safe Helm post-upgrade ordering) that can be rolled out as operator-3.4.1-hotfix; 3) a customer-facing rollback and remediation runbook and QA validation with two escalations (Acme Payments, Cloudware Logistics).
steps: Triage incident and capture full incident timeline from PagerDuty and customer logs
Reproduce minimal repro on internal onprem lab cluster using upgrade matrix (Helm v3.11, operator-3.3.x -> 3.4.0)
Add parity preflight check that verifies CR vs kv-store hash and surface as cluster-health warning
Implement operator patch to make CR writes idempotent and add compensating reconciliation for kv-shadow records
Add Helm post-upgrade ordering guard (block until parity preflight passes or run compensating job)
Create canary: staged rollout to non-production tenants then to Dedicated private beta customers
Publish customer rollback-and-remediate runbook and train SE on execution steps
Coordinate hotfix release and monitor metrics for regressions for 72h after rollout
acceptance_criteria: Pre-upgrade parity check runs and surfaces high-confidence alert if mismatch detected
Operator patch merged and passing CI + integration tests (helm upgrade path covered)
Canary rollout successful for 3 test clusters with no reconcile loops observed
Customer runbook validated with SEs and executed successfully for two previously impacted tenants
Grafana dashboard updated to show kv-parity metric, and SLOs for reconcile loop rate improved by >90%
Hotfix images and Helm chart annotated with migration flag and published to release channel
updates: 2026-03-02: Initial PagerDuty incident PD-7582 opened by SE responding to Acme Payments escalation; collected operator logs and helm-history dumps
2026-03-03: Reproduced failure in lab against helm v3.11 and operator-3.4.0; confirmed ordering race where post-upgrade hook applied before kv snapshot replay
2026-03-05: Drafted parity preflight script + added unit tests for CR->kv hash function; linked PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/4128
2026-03-07: Implemented compensating reconcile path to detect kv-shadow entries and heal via idempotent upsert; PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/4139
2026-03-09: Performed internal canary on 3 test tenants; observed one transient reconcile backoff that resolved after compensating reconcile; collecting metrics
2026-03-11: Published runbook draft to Confluence and requested SE review (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/State+Parity+Rescue+Runbook)
2026-03-12: Security review kick-off scheduled; hotfix candidate image operator:3.4.1-hotfix built and pushed to internal registry (registry.redwood.ai/operator:3.4.1-hotfix)
comments: Marina Gomez (PM): Please ensure the runbook includes exact kubectl commands and Helm rollback examples; customers found earlier runbooks ambiguous
Ravi Sinha (SRE): Add metric 'operator.reconcile.loop_rate' and alert threshold at 5x baseline for immediate paging
Liam O'Connor (assignee): We'll gate Helm post-upgrade hook execution behind the parity check; if parity fails, we create a compensating job and pause the release - temporary conservative approach
Design note: prefer small targeted patches over broad schema migrations to reduce blast radius during hotfix rollout
mitigation_steps_short: Deployed emergency operator image with backoff patch to affected clusters and executed manual kv-sync job for two tenants; temporarily disabled automated upgrades for impacted customer namespaces
